nostr-tools 2.23.5
==================

Vendored browser bundle used by the static Nostr client for:

- NIP-19 parsing and encoding (`note1`, `nevent1`, `npub`, `nsec`)
- anonymous local key generation
- NIP-01 event finalization and signing
